text: The bug was an off-by-one in `sliding_window`'s implementation: `enumerate(itertools.tee(seq, n), 1)` started numbering the tee'd iterators at 1 instead of 0, causing each iterator to skip one extra element than intended (the i-th iterator should skip `i` elements for 0-indexed `i`, not `i+1`). This dropped the first window and caused sequences of length exactly `n` to yield nothing. Fixed by removing the `1` start argument so enumeration begins at 0, matching the number of elements each iterator should skip.

final_text: The bug was an off-by-one in `sliding_window`'s implementation: `enumerate(itertools.tee(seq, n), 1)` started numbering the tee'd iterators at 1 instead of 0, causing each iterator to skip one extra element than intended (the i-th iterator should skip `i` elements for 0-indexed `i`, not `i+1`). This dropped the first window and caused sequences of length exactly `n` to yield nothing. Fixed by removing the `1` start argument so enumeration begins at 0, matching the number of elements each iterator should skip.
